cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll do the speech debrief now. I stayed to the end; was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll note that down. But first, tell me whether staying counted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It counted. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save the notes for next week. Can I put the speech away for tomorrow and still call today a success?

reason: Have A manage and revise the debrief sequence while asking B whether the completed effort earns rest; preserve the omission and practical help rather than demand dishonest praise.
